rationale: Both use gradient x label-separation attribution, latent_examples, and true-logit minimal pairs. A picks cues by max |g| on key latents (keeps probe 3 register), uses a 2x2 factorial and token-level scans over top-|g| ranks. B uses a dependence-ratio threshold, filler re-measurement, and pooled pure-detector latent sets; it checks with a removal fraction, not per-set ablation.
